description: This Java source file defines the `NameSupport` class, which manages name layout templates within the OpenMRS system. It handles initialization, deserialization of templates from XML, updating templates based on global properties, and supports global property change events.

classes.name: NameSupport
classes.description: A singleton class extending LayoutSupport that manages name layout templates and responds to global property changes related to name formatting.

methods.name: NameSupport
methods.description: Constructor that implements singleton pattern initialization.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NameSupport or throws an exception if not yet instantiated.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes layout templates based on the global property 'layout.name.template'.

methods.name: updateLayoutTemplates
methods.description: Updates the current list of layout templates with a new template.

methods.name: deserializeXmlTemplate
methods.description: Deserializes a NameTemplate object from its XML representation.

methods.name: getDefaultLayoutFormat
methods.description: Returns the default layout format, either from global property or predefined.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Checks if the given property name is supported for updates (specifically 'layout.name.template').

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when a global property changes, reloading the name template accordingly.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Placeholder for handling deletion of global properties (no implementation).
